generated_notes: All values are criterion MEDIAN point estimates measured by `cargo bench` on the repo at commit dc3051d, converted from nanoseconds to the unit implied by each key (ms or s). Measured on local synthetic in-repo data only; no provider or network calls. See bench-to-metric mapping and corpus caveats in the per-metric *_notes fields and docs/perf.md.

mimir_init_ms.measured_corpus: fresh tempdir workspace, init_project_files writes the default project scaffold
mimir_init_ms.notes: Maps to `mimir init` (<100ms). Median 1415290.65 ns => 1.415291 ms.

cold_startup_warm_cache_ms.measured_corpus: in-tempdir synthetic repo (5 small .rs files + AGENTS.md)
cold_startup_warm_cache_ms.notes: The context_packet_build bench rebuilds the RepoIndex from scratch each iteration (no IndexCache reuse), so it actually measures the NO-cache path. A genuinely warm-cache build can only be faster, so this value is a conservative UPPER BOUND on the warm-cache target. No separate warm-cache bench exists yet. Median 646874.96 ns => 0.646875 ms.

cold_startup_no_cache_ms.measured_corpus: in-tempdir synthetic repo (5 small .rs files + AGENTS.md)
cold_startup_no_cache_ms.notes: Same context_packet_build bench. It builds the index cold each iteration, so it is the no-cache path. CORPUS CAVEAT: the synthetic repo is only ~6 tiny files, far smaller than a typical task repo, so the absolute figure is an underestimate of a real no-cache cold start; it is recorded as the actual measured value, not extrapolated upward. Median 646874.96 ns => 0.646875 ms.

packet_build_small_ms.measured_corpus: in-tempdir synthetic repo (5 small .rs files + AGENTS.md)
packet_build_small_ms.notes: Maps directly to `Packet build, typical small task` (<500ms): the full ContextBuilder::build() path (index + retrieval + seal/hash). Median 646874.96 ns => 0.646875 ms.

repo_index_10k_cold_s.notes: EXTRAPOLATION REQUIRED. Target is 10k files cold (<30s); the bench measures a representative 600-file synthetic tree (a 10k tree is too slow to materialise and iterate under criterion's default sampling). build_index is roughly linear in file count, so the 10k figure extrapolates to ~0.30s (0.017807 s * 10000/600 ~= 0.297 s), still far under the 30s target. The recorded value is the ACTUAL 600-file median, NOT the extrapolation. Median 17807492.26 ns => 0.017807 s.

repo_index_incremental_s.notes: mimir-index has no diff-based incremental API; build_index is a whole-repo builder. The incremental bench rewrites a single source file then re-runs build_index with the OS page cache warm (the realistic 'edit one file then reindex' path). Measured on 600 files, not the full target corpus. Median 18403526.25 ns => 0.018404 s. Target <2s.

token_count_local_ms.measured_corpus: synthetic ~100 KB English text (worst-case of 1KB/10KB/100KB inputs)
token_count_local_ms.notes: Records the largest (100 KB) input as the worst case for `Token count, local` (<50ms). tiktoken-rs caches the BPE internally, so per-call cost is the encode only. Median 6900.25 ns => 0.006900 ms. Smaller inputs: count_local/1035 = 0.000214 ms, count_local/10260 = 0.000816 ms.

tui_render_frame_ms.notes: Maps to `TUI render frame` (<16ms / 60fps). Single full-frame in-memory render, no terminal I/O. Median 461277.23 ns => 0.461277 ms.
